description: Mine Hazards - Tunnels, etc is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. Arcs representing approximate areas above, adjacent to, or affected by old underground mine facilities that have a potential for subsidence in unincorporated Pierce County. Please read metadata for additional information ( Any data download constitutes acceptance of the Terms of Use (. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Maps and Geospatial. Its tags are hazards, mine hazards. The table has 7 columns. The portal shows 2024-07-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
